title: Disc label to typed address, then a portfolio tour
summary: On flat grey a soft disc shrinks into a small icon over a one-line label, a tilted capsule flips flat into an address field that types itself, then three hard cuts tour the live pages: grid, hero with a sliding photo strip, item page.
use_when: Announcing a portfolio, shop or landing page where the address is the call to action
A short teaser that ends on real footage of the live pages
Creators or studios sharing a new personal page in under 8 s

look.type_style: intro label: medium grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, cap height ~7 % H, near-black; address field: small grotesk ~1.5 % H in a white capsule; page hero (recording): heavy grotesk all caps, tight

sfx.event: soft disc lands as the small icon (0.77 s)
address characters typed into the capsule (2.77 to 3.27 s)
hard cut from the grey intro into the page recording (3.87 s)

structure.shot: flat grey; soft disc shrinks into a small icon above a 1-word label that grows to 3 words; label dims; tilted capsule flips flat into an address field, address types, field blurs out
structure.camera: locked frame, no camera move (only elements scale and rotate)
structure.motion: 0.00 empty; 0.27 large blurred disc (~0.18 W) + label word blur-in; disc shrinks to ~0.02 W icon by 0.77, springs.ui ~15 fr (overshoot not measurable); 1.27 two more words blur-in to the right; 1.50 icon flips on its x axis (edge-on), back by 1.77; 1.77 label fades to ~40 %; 2.00 capsule enters tilted ~4 deg, flips through edge-on at 2.27, flat at 2.50, springs.ui ~22 fr (±0.25 s); 2.77 to 3.27 address typed (typewriter, ~14 chars/0.5 s); 3.50 hold; 3.77 blur + fade out 3 to 6 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: recording of a light shop page: grid of three tall dark artworks with title and price under each; section heading appears at top
structure.camera: pull-out 1.30 -> 1.00 over ~15 fr, easings.outExpo (±0.25 s), measured from card width 0.27 W -> 0.21 W
structure.motion: the grid zooms out and drifts down into place; nothing else animates

structure.shot: page hero: big all-caps studio name, 2-line sub-line, two buttons (black filled, white outline), full-width strip of tall photos below; cursor over the strip
structure.camera: locked frame; the photo strip slides left inside the page
structure.motion: strip slides left ~420 px @1920 over 1.27 s, decelerating (~380 px/s in second 4, ~195 px/s in second 5), easings.outQuint; a small page-preview thumbnail bottom right fades out by 5.00 (±0.25 s); hero text static

structure.shot: item page: one dark artwork fills ~70 % of the frame on the left; right panel with title, two license chips, 4 spec lines, black buy button with price
structure.camera: locked frame; motion.json reports a slow vertical drift (~250 px/s @1920, ~5 deg) inside the artwork area only, the panel stays fixed
structure.motion: artwork drifts slowly upward (easings.linear, not resolvable on sheets); cursor rests on the artwork; holds to the end

params.brand: brand.json: bg (flat grey intro), fg for the label, display font
params.content.label: intro line, 1 word that extends to 3 (invites the viewer to look)
params.content.icon: small round icon or mark the disc shrinks into
params.content.url: address typed into the capsule, ~15 to 25 chars
params.content.clips: 3 screen-recording clips: grid/listing page (0.53 s), hero with a sliding strip (1.53 s), item/detail page (1.83 s)
params.aspect: 16:9 (recorded pages are landscape); other aspects need recrops

notes: All times from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s) and cuts.json; no 30 fps strips were made. Springs are defaults chosen from the 4 fps cells (overshoot not measurable). The 0 to 3.87 s intro is one shot (< 4 s, not split by the rule); its internal states are timed in the motion field. Music only, no VO; all sfx are planned by the glue rule, not measured. cut_on_beat 0/3 (the detected beats stop at 3.69 s). Cut at 4.40 sits 1 fr from an onset at 4.435. The cursor in rows 3 and 4 is the real recorded cursor, not a spring cursor. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): disc-shrink-icon, capsule-flip, label-extend, strip-slide.
